decisionsTitle: The shop's editor: a product list, one page per product, many pictures, «Mărimile» with a size chart, a rich description
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-10, trying the shop on QA with the supplier's sheet in hand:** «The shop CRUD is not intuitive at all… I need to be able to add multiple pictures of the product.» «On the Variants and stock I need that rich text editor so I can add table and pictures.» «I need to be able to define size — can't you see the Excel?» The sheet: three products (a short-sleeve shirt, a long-sleeve shirt, a buff), nine sizes XXS–4XL for the shirts, one size for the buff, a size chart with chest width and length in centimetres per size, euro prices. And his standing rule for everything built now: component-based, vibe-coder friendly, easy to use — one named Server Component per card, house primitives only, the club edits everything without code.

**What was wrong.** §683 drew the whole shop as one card of folds on one page: the products, each an edit fold with a «Variante și stoc» box of typed lines («M: 10»), one photo, the payment words and the orders list stacked under each other. A product with nine sizes was nine lines to type in the right spelling; a second picture had nowhere to go; a description was a plain box.

**Decision — the routes and the tabs.** `/admin/shop` is «Produse», the product list: one row per product — the cover thumbnail, the name, the price in its currency, the sizes with their stock, how many pictures and orders it has, «Vizibil»/«Ascuns» — each a link to its own page, ↑ / ↓ for whoever manages the shop, and «Adaugă un produs». «Comenzi» (`/admin/shop/orders`: the orders list, its filter in the address, the CSV, the verbs and «Adaugă o comandă pentru un membru» of §690, unchanged in behaviour) and «Setări» (`/admin/shop/settings`: «Cum se plătește» and «Cine primește comenzile», with the translate button) are its own pages, as a row of secondary tabs (`ShopTabs`, §516's shape). One `layout.tsx` gate (`canReadShop`) sits above the loading boundary over all of them; every page asks it again; every verb's action and service assert `canManageShop` (BR-REQ-060-01). The shop's server actions moved to `admin/shop/actions.ts`; `ShopCard` is retired.

**One page per product (`/admin/shop/products/new`, `/admin/shop/products/[id]`), five cards in reading order, each a named Server Component under `content/shop/ui/`:** `ProductPicturesCard` («Fotografiile»), `ProductNameCard` («Denumirea și prețul», with «Copiază și tradu tot: RO → EN» at the top), `ProductDescriptionCard` («Descrierea»), `ProductSizesCard` («Mărimile și stocul») and `ProductPublishCard` («Publicarea» with «Vizibil în magazin» and the one «Salvează»); last, `ProductRemoveCard` («Șterge» / «Arhivează», §683's rule). The four text cards are one form (`ProductForm`) posting against the version it loaded (AGENTS.md §11.5); a refusal returns every box as typed and names its card (§315). A reader who may not manage the shop (the Organizer) sees the pictures and the facts, no box; a volunteer holding «Gestionează magazinul» (§687) gets the forms; a volunteer without it gets the 404 any typed address gets. `/admin/shop/products/new` is for `canManageShop` alone.

**The pictures.** A table `shop_product_pictures` (`product_id` cascade, `media_asset_id` set null, `crop` jsonb — §541's four fractions or null — `position` ≥ 1, index on `(product_id, position)`), at most eight per product. Each picture is its own small form on the product's page: «Adaugă o fotografie» through «Echipa»'s picture field (§485's gallery picker, the quality choice, the crop box), ↑ / ↓, «Scoate fotografia» (asked first — members see the strip), «Înlocuiește sau decupează» (another stored picture in the same place, or a new crop, one save). The first by position is the cover, and every change mirrors it onto `shop_products.photo_media_asset_id` / `photo_crop` — §474's pattern: code and rows from §683 keep working, nothing reads them new. A picture never touches the product's `version`, so a picture added while the form is open does not turn its save into a CONFLICT. One audit action, `shop.product.pictures_changed` (the product's id, the change, the count — never a title). The pictures come after the first save: the new product's page says so.

**The description.** `shop_products.description_ro_json` / `description_en_json`, the house rich-text editor with tables and pictures allowed (the owner's table and drawing), one tab per language, both or neither (§352); `description_ro` / `description_en` are the plain twins every save writes (§474). The zone renders it through the one renderer (AGENTS.md §11.3). `media/references.ts` counts a picture of the strip by id and a picture in either description by address: the pictures page lists them as used by the shop, the orphan sweep and the delete guard honour them.

**«Mărimile».** `STANDARD_SIZES = XXS · XS · S · M · L · XL · XXL · 3XL · 4XL` in `content/shop/domain.ts`, drawn as a tick row with a stock box beside each (empty: no limit; 0: sold out); «Mărime unică» with its own «Stoc» box (§683's one variant with no label); «Alte variante» for what is not a size — a colour, a children's cut — one per line as §683 had them. A size is still a `shop_product_variants` row with that label: the lock, the stock rule and the orders of §683 are untouched, and the stock a form loaded still travels with it so a save that did not touch a number leaves it as the orders left it (`stockToSave`). The variant order is the standard order, then «Mărime unică», then the free labels; the zone's select reads the same order. A free label that spells a size is refused (tick it instead). **Unticking a size that has any order — cancelled ones included — is refused on «Mărimile» (`SHOP_SIZE_HAS_ORDERS`)**: the order's variant id would dangle and its stock would have nowhere to go back to; the Administrator sets its stock to 0 instead. §683's save deleted the row and left the order with its copy; that rule is gone. `parseVariantLines` stays for an older form or a script posting the lines box.

**«Tabelul de mărimi».** `shop_products.size_chart` jsonb, `{ columns: [{ ro, en }], rows: { "S": [48, 66.5] } }`, up to four measured columns named in both languages and a number (or null) per ticked size, a CHECK on the shape and the rest validated at the save (each row's label a variant's, numbers or null, each column both languages or neither). The zone draws it as a table under the product, folded, the numbers in the reader's locale («66,5» / «66.5»).

**The zone (`MembersShop.tsx`).** The product card shows the cover large in its crop and the rest as a strip of thumbnails, each a plain link to the picture (no script, 44 px targets); a product written before the strip shows §683's one photo as its cover. Then the rich description, the size chart's fold, the sizes in the fixed order. Nothing else changes for ordering.

**The design system (§694).** Every glyph of the shop's cards comes from `action-icons.ts` — a `sizeChart` ruler added for the chart's fold — every chip is a `GlyphChip`, every button a house primitive; `tests/unit/design` holds it. The shop's words stay under `Admin.members.shop.*` (one namespace, no duplicates), the zone's under `Members.shop.*`; the lines box's words are gone from both catalogues.

**Refused, and why.** A cart or a payment on the site — unchanged (§683: payment is never on the site). A picture per variant — the strip is the product's; a colour that needs its own picture is its own product. A free-text size chart — a table with numbers reads on a phone, free text does not. Deleting a size that has orders — refused rather than orphaning the order's copy, above. A client-side editor for the whole page — each card is a Server Component and the only islands are the house's own (the picker, the rich-text editor, the crop box), so the page works with JavaScript off but for the editor's own boxes.

**Proof.** `tests/integration/cms/shop-editor.test.ts` (the sizes to variants in the fixed order with their stock, the chart's rows for ticked sizes only, the untouched stock after an order, the refused untick, the rich description with a table and a picture and its plain twins, the pictures added/moved/replaced/removed with the cover mirror and one audit action, the references and the delete guard, the zone's cover, strip, chart and size order, the cards' HTML, and every page's gate per role and for a grant holder); `tests/unit/content/shop-domain.test.ts` (the sizes form, the chart's parsing and reading); `tests/integration/cms/members-shop.test.ts` (§683's cases, with the new rule on the unticked size); `tests/integration/cms/boundary.test.ts` and `tests/e2e/client-words.spec.ts` carry the new routes. `SETUP.md` §43 is rewritten for the new screens.

Amends §683 (the editor and the zone paragraphs; the save's rule on a removed variant), §686 (the price box lives on «Denumirea și prețul»), §687 («Magazin» is three tabs and a page per product), §690 (the fold lives on «Comenzi») and §482's shop paragraph (the product's button is at the top of «Denumirea și prețul»).

**After the review (2026-10-11).** Migration `0138` also backfills: each product's one photo of §683 (`photo_media_asset_id` / `photo_crop`) becomes its first picture, position 1, the crop copied, for a product that has no picture yet — idempotent, so a product keeps its picture in the editor and the zone (`tests/integration/db/shop-pictures-backfill-migration.test.ts`). «Copiază și tradu tot» on the product's form now knows the rich description: `descriptionEnBody` is on the allowlist and a rich text, its Romanian twin `descriptionRoBody`; the plain `descriptionEn` stays for the codes' form. «Vizibil» and «Salvează» are a bar of their own after the last card, sticky to the bottom while the long form scrolls (`bottom: 44`, as the event editor's button is), 44 px targets. The zone's strip of thumbnails scrolls sideways with CSS scroll-snap rather than wrapping. `variantsInShopOrder` is gone: the save writes the variants in the fixed order into `position`, and every read follows `position` (a product saved before the editor shows its variants in their stored order until it is saved once). The help under the photo and under the description say what is true of the new cards. `client-words.spec.ts` also opens the first existing product's page, the only one drawing the picture field with its crop box.
changelogLine: - **The shop's editor, rebuilt** — «Magazin» is three tabs («Produse», «Comenzi», «Setări») and one page per product with its cards in order: many pictures with the first as cover, a rich description with tables and pictures, «Mărimile» as ticks XXS–4XL with a stock each and a size chart; the members' zone shows the cover, a picture strip, the description and the chart. A size that has orders cannot be unticked. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: «Magazin» is `/admin/shop` («Produse»), `/admin/shop/orders`, `/admin/shop/settings`, `/admin/shop/products/new` and `/admin/shop/products/[id]`, gated `canReadShop` in one layout above the loading boundary and again on each page; the new product's page and every verb (the product's save, the pictures, the settings, the orders) are `canManageShop`'s, asserted by the action and the service — a reader sees the cards and no box, a volunteer holding «Gestionează magazinul» gets the forms, a volunteer without it gets 404 (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A product carries up to eight pictures in `shop_product_pictures`, each with its crop; a product's one photo of §683 is its first picture after migration `0138`; the first by position is the cover, mirrored onto `shop_products.photo_media_asset_id` / `photo_crop` at every change; adding, moving, replacing and removing a picture never changes the product's version and leaves one audit row `shop.product.pictures_changed` naming no title; the pictures page counts a strip picture by id and a description picture by address, and refuses to delete either (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Mărimile» posts the ticked standard sizes XXS · XS · S · M · L · XL · XXL · 3XL · 4XL, each with a stock box, «Mărime unică» and the free labels; the save writes them as `shop_product_variants` rows in that fixed order through the one stock rule, leaving an untouched size's stock as the orders left it, and refuses to untick a size that has any order (`SHOP_SIZE_HAS_ORDERS`, naming «Mărimile»); the size chart keeps up to four columns named in both languages and a number per ticked size (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The product's description is a rich text with tables and pictures in both languages or neither, its plain twins written by every save; the members' zone draws the cover large, the other pictures as a scroll-snap strip of plain links, the description through the public renderer, the size chart as a table in the reader's locale and the sizes in the fixed order (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Copiază și tradu tot: RO → EN» fills the product's rich description (`descriptionEnBody` from `descriptionRoBody`) and refuses every name not on its allowlist; «Vizibil» and «Salvează» are a sticky bar at the bottom of the product's form (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
